name: Sainohara Megumu
source:
Position of the mark: On the stomach
Curse: [spoiler]Forbidden to speak anything true about oneself[/spoiler]
Gift: [spoiler]Ability to steal/absorb the life force of other by killing them[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Megumu is a cool guy except that underneath those man's clothes is actually a girl. She is a girl by mind and heart and is neither a tomboy nor a hardcore lesbian, not even a pervert who has interest in cross-dressing. Her peculiar fashion has a deep and profound meaning though it is not directly related to her curse and gift.[/spoiler]
